display_long_description:
The ride of your life, from the seat - all the way round Columbus, Ohio.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage in Harrison West. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto the street.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist back to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean into a corner. Tuck behind the screen for top speed, or turn wheelie control off and lift the front.

38 KM ROUND COLUMBUS
SR 315 - the Olentangy Freeway - north past Ohio Stadium and the Ohio State campus, up the river valley through Clintonville to I-270, the Outerbelt, across Worthington, then I-71 south all the way back in and I-670 above the Short North with LeVeque Tower and the downtown skyline beside you. Real roads, real hills, real towers.

ROAD EVENTS + SPEED TRAPS
Seven events on real roads - race for gold against your own ghost bike. Six speed cameras, and Rush Hour near-miss combos on I-71.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden hour over the Olentangy, bright sun, or the city at night on your headlight with the traffic's tail lights ahead.

YOUR WAY
Choose how much the view leans, bar vibration on or off, automatic or a six-speed sequential box. Speeds in mph. English and Spanish.
